plan.title: bug(run-summary): seq lock live-holder reclaim needs ownership check (#3350 residual)

narratives.Description: PR 3353 seq lock can be stolen by mtime if a live writer stays in the critical section longer than the 2s wait. Greptile also wants fail-closed acquire, but fail-open after a bounded wait remains the #3282 contract.
narratives.Overview:
## Summary

PR #3353 landed Option A file-destination seq seed plus a sibling lock and stale-lock reclaim. Greptile on HEAD cc7da373995d81633bf0b4848358f6ba98509e70 still holds at Confidence 3/5 with advisory should-not-merge.

## Residual

Inline P1: if a live writer spends longer than the 2s wait window recounting or appending, another process deletes the lock by mtime and both can append the same seq. Greptile also wants fail-closed acquire (no proceed without the lock).

## Why not in #3353

- Fail-open is the #3282 run-summary contract (emission never throws / never changes exit codes).
- Owner-token / live-PID reclaim is a new lock protocol, not the thin Option A count-then-append story.
- Review-cycle #2881: do not invent a new reliability subsystem mid-babysit.

## Suggested follow-up (thin)

- Write a lock owner token (pid + nonce) and reclaim only when that process is dead.
- Keep fail-open after a bounded wait; do not block CLI exit codes.
- Test live-holder vs dead-holder reclaim.

Refs #3350 #3353 #3282.
narratives.UserStory: As a telemetry consumer, I want live lock holders to keep ownership until they finish or die, so that two processes cannot append the same destination-wide seq.
narratives.ImplementationPlan: In packages/core/src/run-summary/emit.ts, store a lock owner token (pid + nonce) and reclaim only when that process is dead. Keep fail-open after a bounded wait. Land on existing PR 3353. Evidence: pnpm exec vitest run packages/core/src/run-summary plus CHANGELOG #3361.

narrative.Acceptance: Given a live writer holds the seq lock, when another process waits past 2s, it does not delete that lock by mtime. Reclaim is allowed only when the owner process is dead.
Given lock acquire cannot complete within the wait window, when emit continues, it fail-opens without throwing or changing CLI exit codes, per #3282.
Given live-holder and dead-holder tests, when they run they pass. CHANGELOG [Unreleased] cites #3361. Land on PR 3353 and drive that PR to merge-ready.
